items.title: Gucci to Stage Cruise 2028 Show in Shanghai
items.summary: Gucci confirmed Demna will stage the Cruise 2028 show in Shanghai on May 17, 2027, marking the 30th anniversary of the brand's first China store opening. It will be Demna's first Shanghai show, following his Cruise 2027 debut staged in New York's Times Square.

items.title: Gucci porterà la cruise 2028 a Shanghai il 17 maggio
items.summary: Italian financial-fashion trade press reports the Shanghai Cruise 2028 announcement as a deliberate signal of renewed courtship of Chinese clients, framed within Kering's broader turnaround priorities for the house under Luca de Meo.

items.title: Gucci choisit Shanghai pour le défilé Croisière 2028 de Demna
items.summary: French trade coverage of the Shanghai Cruise 2028 announcement, noting it follows Demna's New York Cruise 2027 debut and underscores Gucci's effort to re-engage a Chinese market central to its recovery.

items.title: Gucci wählt Shanghai als Schauplatz für Demnas Cruise-Show 2028
items.summary: German-language trade write-up of the same Shanghai Cruise 2028 news, descriptive in tone, situating it as part of the 30th China-anniversary celebration.

items.title: Demna sceglie la Cina. La sfilata Gucci Cruise 2028 volerà a Shanghai
items.summary: Italian fashion-magazine piece framing the Shanghai Cruise show choice as evidence Demna is prioritizing the Chinese market for Gucci's recovery narrative, mostly descriptive with light editorial framing.

items.title: Rekindled Gucci desirability fails to light flame under Kering sales
items.summary: AFP wire report (still circulating/cited in this week's follow-on coverage) notes Gucci Q3 sales fell 4% to EUR1.29bn even as Kering's other houses grew 2%; Gucci's share of group revenue has slid from over 50% historically to about 40%. CEO Luca de Meo cites a softer macro environment while calling Gucci's recovery the group's defining priority.

items.title: Kering : la stabilité du groupe laisse entière la question Gucci
items.summary: French analysis argues Kering's group-level stability masks an unresolved Gucci problem: store traffic keeps declining and better conversion/average ticket cannot yet offset fewer visitors, so the quarter does not yet prove a sustainable Gucci recovery.

items.title: ReconKering: How Luca de Meo Plans to Turn Around Gucci and Kering
items.summary: Trade analysis of de Meo's 'reset-rebuild-reclaim' roadmap for Kering, detailing plans to refurbish or relocate two-thirds of Gucci's store network, cut outlet count by a third, and double leather goods' sales-density contribution by 2030 -- implicitly acknowledging the current retail footprint is unproductive.

items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign & 'Boring' Styling
items.summary: Roundup of TikTok fan reaction to Gucci's Mariah Carey 'Gucci Gift' holiday campaign, citing viewer comments calling the ad cold, sterile and outdated versus festive, with one commenter likening it to a budget-store attempt at luxury.

items.title: TikTok reaction video to Gucci x Mariah Carey holiday ad
items.summary: User reaction video calling the Gucci holiday ad's party scene emotionless and comparing the mood to a horror-film gathering rather than festive cheer; representative of a wider wave of similar TikTok reaction clips circulating in early November.

items.title: Gucci official account promotes 'Gucci Gift' holiday campaign and LACMA Art+Film Gala coverage
items.summary: Gucci's brand-owned X account is running a steady cadence of posts promoting the Mariah Carey holiday campaign and the LACMA Art+Film Gala ambassador presence; brand-owned promotional posting, counted as activation coverage rather than independent opinion.

items.title: Demna's New LA FAMIGLIA Has Dropped. Will You be Buying?
items.summary: Active PurseForum thread on Demna's newest Gucci drop; members are split, with some saying the designs make Gucci feel cool and young again and others repeating familiar complaints that it strays too far from heritage Gucci codes. Mixed sentiment, no dominant verdict.

items.title: 2026 Gucci Flora
items.summary: Product-focused PurseForum thread discussing the 2026 Gucci Flora coated-canvas pieces (totes, bucket bags); largely descriptive/appreciative consumer chat about colorways and craftsmanship, low emotional intensity.

items.title: Vittoria Ceretti Channels Tom Ford's Iconic Gucci Era in the 2026 Gucci Handbags Campaign
items.summary: Forum-buzz style article/thread comparing the current Gucci handbags campaign to the Tom Ford era; nostalgic, broadly positive consumer-forum reaction praising the throwback styling over Demna's more divisive runway output.

items.title: Gucci Has Lost the Plot. But What If It Works?
items.summary: Independent fashion commentary arguing Gucci under Demna has visibly abandoned coherent house identity, but entertaining the contrarian possibility that the disruption is a deliberate, eventually commercially effective strategy. Genuinely two-sided with no firm verdict.

items.title: Gucci Isn't Failing. It Just Isn't For You
items.summary: Contrarian independent commentary pushing back on the 'Gucci is failing' narrative, arguing the brand has deliberately narrowed its audience rather than lost relevance; a counter-voice to the dominant negative-earnings framing elsewhere in the pool.

items.title: Gucci to Stage Cruise 2028 Show in Shanghai
items.summary: Jing Daily's brief intel note on the Shanghai Cruise 2028 announcement, framed through the lens of luxury brands' renewed courtship of Chinese consumers after a weak 2026 China performance across the sector.

items.title: Supereroi senza super poteri: la crisi degli autori nella moda dei conglomerati
items.summary: Italian trade analysis using Gucci/Demna's turnaround as a case study for whether star-designer-led fixes still work inside financially squeezed conglomerate structures; skeptical, analytically negative-leaning framing.
